modmenu.descriptionTranslation.where_win: Adds fuller vanilla grass coverage to grassy biomes.
where_winds_blow.config.title: Where Winds Blow
where_winds_blow.config.terrain.tooltip: World generation settings for Where Winds Blow grass patches.
where_winds_blow.config.wind.tooltip: Shared simulation settings for wind direction, strength, weather, and calm periods.
where_winds_blow.config.rendering.toolti: Client-side visual settings for wind, foliage, smoke, and renderer compatibility.
where_winds_blow.config.group.worldgen.d: Controls the added grass and wild wheat patches placed in newly generated chunks.
where_winds_blow.config.group.interactiv: Controls how nearby moving entities bend supported foliage.
where_winds_blow.config.group.windSimula: Controls the shared atmospheric wind state used by every visual effect.
where_winds_blow.config.group.dynamicDir: Controls how long the prevailing flow holds and how far it can gradually turn.
where_winds_blow.config.group.lulls.desc: Controls smooth calm periods that let foliage, smoke, lanterns, and signs settle.
where_winds_blow.config.group.gusts.desc: Controls bounded wind fronts that travel across the world and affect nearby systems in sequence.
where_winds_blow.config.group.localExpos: Controls cached, direction-aware shelter and subtle high-altitude wind scaling.
where_winds_blow.config.group.biomeProfi: Controls data-driven biome multipliers loaded from wind profile resources.
where_winds_blow.config.group.advanced.d: Development and diagnostic controls for the wind simulation.
where_winds_blow.config.group.foliage.de: Controls model detection, custom foliage rendering, and wind sheen highlights.
where_winds_blow.config.group.windMotion: Controls wind-driven plant and leaf sway.
where_winds_blow.config.group.weather.de: Controls how clear skies, rain, and thunder change wind intensity, foliage sway, and sheen.
where_winds_blow.config.group.ambientWin: Controls visible wind streaks, drifting leaves, and campfire smoke movement.
where_winds_blow.config.group.compatibil: Controls renderer integration and shader-pack behavior.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDenseGrass: Turns this mod's added grass world generation on or off. Requires a world reload and only affects newly generated chunks.
where_winds_blow.config.denseGrassDensit: Multiplies dense short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.mediumGrassDensi: Multiplies medium short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.sparseGrassDensi: Multiplies sparse short grass generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.tallGrassPatchMu: Multiplies tall grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.shortDryGrassPat: Multiplies short dry grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.tallDryGrassPatc: Multiplies tall dry grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.deadGrassPatchMu: Multiplies dead grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.overgrownGrassPa: Multiplies overgrown grass patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.wildWheatPatchMu: Multiplies wild wheat patch generation passes. Values are rounded to whole passes when biome modifiers load.
where_winds_blow.config.enableFoliageInt: Lets nearby entities push and bend supported foliage on the client.
where_winds_blow.config.foliageInteracti: Scales how strongly supported foliage reacts when entities move through it.
where_winds_blow.config.enableAutodetect: Lets Where Winds Blow animate compatible plant-like models from Minecraft and other mods.
where_winds_blow.config.enableCustomFoli: Uses Where Winds Blow's custom foliage shader for vanilla cutout foliage render types.
Enables the bright moving sheen that travels across responsive foliage in the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windSheenStrengt: Scales the visible intensity of the wind sheen highlight.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindStreak: Adds sparse, pale wind lines and biome-tinted leaves that drift through the air.
where_winds_blow.config.windStreakVisibi: Scales the overall amount of ambient wind lines and drifting leaves.
Scales how many wind lines spawn.
Scales how many drifting leaf particles spawn.
where_winds_blow.config.windStreakOpacit: Scales how opaque wind lines are.
Scales how opaque drifting leaf particles are.
where_winds_blow.config.windStreakThickn: Sets the maximum wind line stroke width. Individual strokes vary down to about half this value.
where_winds_blow.config.windDirectionDeg: Sets the fixed or prevailing wind direction in compass degrees clockwise from north. 0 is north, 90 is east, 180 is south, and 270 is west.
where_winds_blow.config.enableDynamicWin: Enables slow atmospheric strength variation, direction changes, and lulls. Disabling it retains weather-scaled fixed wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windDirectionMod: Lets the prevailing direction evolve over time or remain fixed at the configured compass bearing.
where_winds_blow.config.overallWindStren: Scales the strength produced by the shared wind simulation without changing individual effect settings.
where_winds_blow.config.dynamicDirection: Scales how far dynamic wind may wander during an ordinary direction change.
where_winds_blow.config.minimumDirection: Minimum number of seconds before the simulation chooses a new direction target.
where_winds_blow.config.maximumDirection: Maximum number of seconds before the simulation chooses a new direction target.
where_winds_blow.config.maximumOrdinaryD: Limits normal direction changes in degrees. Severe storms can rarely turn farther.
Allows smooth calm periods that reduce every system's shared wind input.
where_winds_blow.config.windLullFrequenc: Scales how often calm periods occur. Zero prevents them.
where_winds_blow.config.windLullStrength: Sets how much normal wind remains at the calmest point of a lull.
where_winds_blow.config.enableGustFronts: Allows up to three coherent gust bands to travel through the visible world at once.
where_winds_blow.config.gustFrequency.to: Scales how often gust fronts form. Rain and thunder naturally increase their frequency.
where_winds_blow.config.gustStrength.too: Scales the extra wind force carried by travelling gust fronts.
Sets the average speed of gust fronts in blocks per second.
where_winds_blow.config.gustWidth.toolti: Sets the average width of each gust band in blocks.
where_winds_blow.config.turbulenceStreng: Scales controlled crosswind, flutter, smoke curl, and leaf tumbling around the main flow.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindDebugO: Shows a compact live readout of direction, strength, gusts, turbulence, and exposure.
where_winds_blow.config.enableLocalWindE: Reduces wind continuously behind walls, roofs, and foliage using a shared short-lived cache.
where_winds_blow.config.windExposureRadi: Sets how many nearby blocks the bounded upwind shelter pattern samples.
where_winds_blow.config.altitudeWindInfl: Scales the subtle wind increase toward the top of the current dimension's build range.
where_winds_blow.config.enableBiomeWindP: Applies reloadable biome-specific strength, gust, turbulence, direction, and altitude behaviour.
Lets campfire smoke drift, curl, and merge into larger wind-shaped plumes.
where_winds_blow.config.windSmokeStrengt: Scales how strongly campfire smoke follows the wind and plume turbulence.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindLanter: Lets hanging lanterns and vertical chain blocks sway with the wind. Rebuilds visible chunks when changed.
where_winds_blow.config.windLanternSwayS: Scales how strongly hanging lanterns and vertical chains respond to wind.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindHangin: Lets hanging signs sway back and forth with the wind.
where_winds_blow.config.windHangingSignS: Scales how strongly hanging signs respond to wind.
where_winds_blow.config.enableStandalone: Lets vertical chain stacks sway even when they do not end in a hanging lantern.
where_winds_blow.config.enableSodiumShad: Adds Where Winds Blow wind uniforms and source injections to Sodium's own terrain shader.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindFoliag: Enables wind-driven sway in the responsive foliage shader.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindPlantS: Enables wind-driven movement for grass, crops, flowers, and other plant-like foliage.
where_winds_blow.config.enableWindLeafSw: Enables wind-driven movement for leaf blocks.
where_winds_blow.config.windFoliageSwayS: Scales the strength of wind-driven foliage motion.
where_winds_blow.config.windPlantSwaySta: Raises the still base of grass, crops, flowers, and other plant-like foliage. Higher values reduce wind sway on simple crossed-plane plants. Rebuilds visible foliage when changed.
where_winds_blow.config.clearWeatherWind: Sets the weather wind power used during clear weather. This affects foliage gust intensity, wind streak density, and wind smoke.
where_winds_blow.config.rainWeatherWindP: Sets the weather wind power reached at full rain. This affects foliage gust intensity, wind streak density, and wind smoke.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderWeatherWi: Sets the weather wind power reached at full thunder. This affects foliage gust intensity, wind streak density, and wind smoke.
where_winds_blow.config.clearWeatherSway: Sets the minimum foliage sway strength during clear weather.
where_winds_blow.config.rainWeatherSwayS: Sets the minimum foliage sway strength reached at full rain.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderWeatherSw: Sets the minimum foliage sway strength reached at full thunder.
where_winds_blow.config.clearWeatherShee: Sets the minimum wind sheen strength during clear weather.
where_winds_blow.config.rainWeatherSheen: Sets the minimum wind sheen strength reached at full rain.
where_winds_blow.config.thunderWeatherSh: Sets the minimum wind sheen strength reached at full thunder.
